title: One Connect is enough, with sandbox accounts for testing
description: An app's account no longer has separate Test and Production settings: one Connect works for test runs and live runs. Add a sandbox account to an app, and test runs (an agent's Test panel, drafts, Real on a Tool's page) use it while live runs never do. Without one, a test run's write on the live account waits for approval. Existing sign-ins must be made again once.
